body.ruleText:
rule dac_gh_0028 {
  meta:
    author = "Detection Engineer"
    description = "GitHub: Push protection bypassed or disabled for org/repo - secret_scanning_push_protection disabled / bypass"
    severity = "High"
    rule_id = "DAC-GH-0028"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1552.001"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "GITHUB"
    ($e.metadata.product_event_type = "secret_scanning_push_protection.bypass" nocase or $e.metadata.product_event_type = "repository_secret_scanning.disable" nocase or $e.metadata.product_event_type = "org.disable_secret_scanning" nocase)

  condition:
    $e
}
